GTA VI: The Album isn't out until Nov 19, but 9 of its 34 songs are already on Spotify with 93.4M streams (as of Oct 20, 2026).

Justice's "Flower In A Hurricane" with Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard was #41 in the US on Oct 19. Fuerza Regida's "Suzuki" is #3 in Mexico. Morgan Wallen's "Last Thing You Need" leads in total streams at 27.7M.

Best GTA VI song so far? 👇

Data: kworb Spotify daily charts and artist page (Oct 19-20, 2026); release details via Rockstar/Atlantic reports
